decision_rules: Use the tree to detect dependence and missing branch breadth; do not count close relatives as independent votes.
No edge lengths or numeric weights are declared by this file.
A surface form appearing in one cohort does not establish pan-Slavic comprehensibility.
Russian and Ukrainian targets are independently translated; they are not the basis for averaging an Interslavic target.
Unrepresented cohorts remain absence, not support.
Community or external certification cannot be inferred from internal corpus coverage.
status_limit: Declared qualitative topology only; not a phylogenetic estimate, scalar readiness score, or certification.
